# Security

ParanO(1)d is pre-genesis software. No public network has launched, and the
protocol and implementation may change before release.

Please report suspected vulnerabilities privately to
<ignotus.nemo@proton.me>. Include the affected commit, expected and observed
behavior, impact, and a minimal reproducer when possible. Do not open a public
issue for an unpatched vulnerability.

Receipt of a report does not imply a bug bounty or other compensation.
